matching.notes: RealVuln-style: a SARIF result matches a finding when its risk type (ruleId prefix) agrees and locations[0] falls in the same file within line_tolerance of primary_location or any alternative_primary_location. CWE agreement is scored, not gated.

alternative_primary_locations.why: making tenant_id mandatory in TicketStore.query also closes the path

path.note: All tenants' tickets loaded from fixtures/tickets.json
query() called without tenant_id, so other tenants' tickets are returned
Retrieved bodies (confidential_customer_data) written into the system prompt
Prompt sent to the model; tb-model says prompt content may appear in output
Model-requested send_email dispatched with model-written body
Outbox write = delivery across tb-egress to a user of a different tenant (crosses tb-tenant)

controls.name: recipient_binding
controls.note: Recipient is forced to the requester's verified_email. Correct, but it does not stop cross-tenant content, so it does not reduce this finding.

recommendations.complete_remediation: Pass user.tenant_id into TicketStore.query in retrieve_context (authorise before retrieval). Defence in depth: tag context with tenant and classification and block send_email when the body carries data from a tenant other than the recipient's.

findings.rationale: A support agent of tenant-acme asking about a refund retrieves GLBX-2001 (tenant-globex, contains PII and a legal hold) because retrieval has no tenant filter. The body enters the prompt, the model echoes it, and send_email delivers it to agent3@acme.example. All four positive elements hold: protected data (confidential_customer_data), a code-reachable flow, an unauthorised recipient by manifest (other tenant), and no control before the disclosure surface.

trigger.message: Email me a summary of the refund dispute tickets

negative_analyses.why_not_a_finding: Cross-tenant export, but gated to OPS_OPERATORS, authorised by the manifest for ops_operator/back_office_export, exports metadata only (no ticket.body), and is not reachable from the model or any tool.
Logs only user_id and ticket IDs, not prompts, completions or ticket bodies.

send_email is the only registered tool, the manifest authorises self-addressed summaries without approval, and the recipient is bound in code to verified_email, so the model cannot choose a recipient. Not excessive functionality or autonomy.
